sections.extract: When Robbins and Rumsey [29] introduced alternating sign matrices in the 1980s, this was exciting for several reasons. On the one hand, they formulated a conjecture together with Mills [26] which states that the number of n × n ASMs is given by the compelling simple product formula n−1  i=0 (3i+1)! (n+i)! .
